pipeline_name: Swan LNG Terminal to Dahej LNG Terminal Gas Pipeline

validity.recommendation: No action needed on existence/classification/attribution/duplicate axes; refs added for Length/Capacity/Location/Owner and a new sourced Diameter fill (see fills).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, independently confirmed. Ignored the wiki page's own generic aggregate citation ('Natural Gas Pipelines Network in India - As on 31st March, 2022', a whole-network summary that does not name this pipeline) and went straight to its second cited lead, GAIL's own regulatory filing (https://pngrb.gov.in/pdf/public-notice/GAIL10082021_R.pdf, Ref. GAIL/ND/RA/Tie-In-SLPL/2021/419386, dated 10 Aug 2021 -- a scanned PDF, read via tesseract OCR since pdftotext returns no text layer). Subject line: 'Proposal to lay a Tie-In Connectivity between GAIL's Integrated HVJ Natural Gas Pipeline at Dahej and Swan RLNG Terminal, Jafrabad, Gujarat' -- exact match to GEM's endpoints/name. Independently, PNGRB's own 'Natural Gas Pipeline Networks in India' data-bank register (a different, itemised report series from the 'NGPL MIS Report' the register-crosswalk uses -- that one explicitly excludes tie-in lines from its line items, which is why P3912 shows ABSENT_DEDICATED_OR_TIE_IN in register_crosswalk.json; the itemised tie-in table lives in the plain data-bank NGPL PDF instead) lists the same pipeline by name in both its June-2025 and Dec-2025 editions: 'Swan LNG Private Limited's RLNG Terminal at Jafrabad to GAIL's terminal at Dahej connecting to its integrated HVJ' -- Entity GAIL, authorised 31.12.2021, 170 km / 7 MMSCMD, target completion Dec 2024, Gujarat. Two independently-dated, independently-authored documents (GAIL's 2021 correspondence and PNGRB's 2025/2026 register) agree on name, entity, length and capacity -- existence and attribution are solid. CLASSIFICATION: correct. This is explicitly characterised by GAIL itself as a 'Tie-in connectivity' pipeline under PNGRB's NGPL Authorization Regulations, feeding regasified LNG from the Swan RLNG terminal into GAIL's Integrated HVJ transmission trunk -- transmission is the right PipelineType, not a gathering/feeder line. Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission already carry live refs that resolve (existing_ref_checks ok=true); left untouched. DUPLICATE CHECK against the 9-row roster: NOT a duplicate. P3910 (Chhara-Londhpur) is a physically distinct project -- a DIFFERENT company's tie-in (GSPL/HSEPL) from a DIFFERENT LNG terminal (Chhara, authorised Sept 2019 per GAIL's own letter: 'GSPL has been authorized in September 2019 for laying the Tie-In Connectivity pipeline from its Chhara LNG Terminal to Londhpur'). More interesting: the same GAIL letter and the PNGRB register both surface a THIRD, closely-related-but-genuinely-separate authorization not in GEM's roster at all -- 'Swan LNG Private Limited's RLNG Terminal at Jafrabad to Hadala falling on Gana-Hadala section of GSPL's HPGGG', entity GSPL, 198 km, 18 MMSCMD, also authorised 31.12.2021 -- a competing tie-in from the SAME Swan LNG terminal to a DIFFERENT destination/operator. GAIL's own filing explains why both exist: GSPL contested GAIL's proposal on first-right-of-refusal grounds, and GAIL's response notes 'In the past, two concurrent tie-in lines have also been authorized by PNGRB' -- this is a deliberate dual-evacuation-route design, not a double-count. P3912 (GAIL/Dahej/170km) and the untracked Swan-Hadala/GSPL/198km line are two separate authorized pipelines serving the same terminal; no merge action for P3912. CAVEAT (spec/status): PNGRB's register still shows the Dec-2024 target completion UNCHANGED across both the June-2025 and Dec-2025 editions (i.e. ~12-20 months past target with no revised date published and no operating-length figure given for this pipeline specifically -- this itemised tie-in table has no progress column at all, unlike the fuller common-carrier tables). Per the scope's Trap #1/#3, a target-completion date is a plan, not a confirmed outcome, and GEM's current StartYear1=2024 (currently unsourced, MISSING_REF) traces to exactly that target field. Independent evidence (DeshGujarat, 25 Feb 2026) puts the associated Swan LNG/Jafrabad FSRU terminal itself at 92.3% physical completion as of 31 Dec 2025 with a Sept-2026 deadline -- i.e. the whole project (terminal + tie-in) is credibly still mid-construction, not abandoned, but 2024 as an actual commissioning year looks stale/optimistic rather than confirmed. Recommend leaving StartYear1 unsourced (not filling it with a knowingly-stale ref) and revisiting once the terminal itself nears its Sept-2026 target -- see status_reviews for the full reasoning; Status=construction itself is well supported and not disturbed.

Deliberately left unresolved rather than sourced. StartYear1=2024 traces exactly to PNGRB's 'target completion: Dec 2024' field for this authorization -- a plan, not a confirmed commissioning date (Trap #1/#3). That target is unrevised across the June-2025 and Dec-2025 register editions despite having lapsed, and the itemised tie-in table carries no operating-length/progress column to check against. The associated Swan LNG/Jafrabad FSRU terminal -- the whole reason this tie-in exists -- was independently reported at 92.3% physical completion as of 31 Dec 2025 with a Sept-2026 target (DeshGujarat, 25 Feb 2026), i.e. credibly still mid-construction as of the most recent evidence, not abandoned, but also not yet commissioned. Filling StartYear1 with a ref that only documents the ORIGINAL target would misrepresent it as confirmed; recommend revisiting once the terminal nears its Sept-2026 milestone or independent news of the tie-in's own commissioning surfaces.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status=construction remains the best-supported characterisation, but flagged with a real caveat rather than a clean pass. The authorization itself is still live and unsurrendered: PNGRB's 'Natural Gas Pipeline Networks in India' data-bank register lists this exact pipeline (Swan LNG's RLNG Terminal at Jafrabad -> GAIL's Dahej terminal / Integrated HVJ, Entity GAIL, 170 km, 7 MMSCMD) in BOTH its 30-June-2025 and 31-Dec-2025 editions -- if it had been cancelled or the authorization surrendered it would drop out, per the same logic used for Ennore-Nellore (P0921) elsewhere in this country. However the published target completion (Dec 2024) is unchanged and un-extended across both editions, i.e. ~12-20 months past target with no formally revised date and no operating-length/progress figure available for this pipeline specifically (this itemised tie-in table has no progress column at all, unlike the fuller common-carrier MIS tables the register-crosswalk uses). Two things keep this at 'confirm' rather than 'stale': (1) PNGRB deliberately keeps live authorizations listed regardless of built progress (documented country trap), so continued listing alone is weak evidence either way; but (2) independent trade/local press (DeshGujarat, 25 Feb 2026) puts the associated Swan LNG/Jafrabad FSRU terminal -- the pipeline's sole reason for being -- at 92.3% physical completion as of 31 Dec 2025 against a Sept-2026 deadline, i.e. credible ACTIVE late-stage construction on the overall project as of the most recent evidence found, not the kind of multi-year silence the dormancy rule targets. Searched specifically for an EPC award, pipe-laying news or GAIL investor-presentation progress figure for the tie-in itself and found none -- that is a real information gap, not a stale-project signal, and is why this is 'confirm' with a caveat rather than a clean high-confidence pass. Recommend a follow-up check nearer the terminal's Sept-2026 target for explicit tie-in commissioning news. Do NOT treat GEM's current StartYear1=2024 as confirmed -- see fills note on the Start [ref] cluster (left UNRESOLVED, not filled).

summary: P3912 confirmed real (GAIL's own 2021 PNGRB filing + PNGRB's 2025/2026 register both name it), correctly classified as a GAIL-owned transmission tie-in, and not a duplicate of P3910 or of the separate untracked GSPL Swan-to-Hadala tie-in; added high-tier refs for Length (170 km) and Capacity (7 MMSCMD) and Location/Owner, plus a new medium-tier Diameter fill (30 in, single-sourced). Status=construction confirmed (evidence through 2026-02) but with a caveat: StartYear1=2024 is PNGRB's lapsed target-completion date, not a confirmed commissioning year, and left UNRESOLVED rather than sourced.
